system.flavor: Drive a lance of compressed gravity into the target.

surges.html: If you damaged this target with a Magecraft Action since the start of your last turn, this attack ignores 1 Defense.
Extend the lance through the target. Compare this Action against one additional creature within 2 units directly behind the target. On a success, that creature takes 1 damage.

rider.title: SPACE - THREAD
rider.html: Create a Space Thread. Before resolving a future Magecraft Action, consume it to increase that Action's range by 2 units, or ignore one intervening creature when determining line of effect.
